idea-plugin.name: Test Scaffold Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Generates a real, compiling JUnit test skeleton for a Java or Kotlin class -- one empty test method per public method, framework already detected from your project's own dependencies and imported correctly. Every skeleton is validated against an in-memory PSI copy before anything is written to disk: if a generated reference can't resolve, nothing gets written for that method -- you get an honest TODO comment instead of a broken or silently-empty test. The #1 complaint against every free alternative in this space (Squaretest, TestMe, JUnitGenerator) is generated code that doesn't compile or a test that "passes" by asserting nothing; this plugin's whole design exists to not do that.

100% local -- no network call, no account, no telemetry. PSI validation always runs off the EDT, same pattern as every other Gap Hunter Labs plugin.
